result:
Found four actionable issues:

- **P2 — Malformed JSON can pass audit.** [streaming.py:26](/Users/dberweger/Local/hu100-export-audit-memory-20261008/src/blueprint/streaming.py:26) uses unrestricted `lstrip()`, accepting vertical tabs, form feeds and Unicode whitespace forbidden by JSON. An in-memory HU100 audit returned `verified` with a vertical tab before the final brace. **Fix:** strip only `' \t\r\n'`.

- **P2 — Valid numbers fail at chunk boundaries.** [streaming.py:41](/Users/dberweger/Local/hu100-export-audit-memory-20261008/src/blueprint/streaming.py:41) retries only when the decoded value consumes the whole buffer. With a buffer ending in `1.` or `1e`, `raw_decode()` returns the prefix `1`, and delimiter validation fails. Reproduced at the real 65,536-character boundary. **Fix:** require a complete numeric token and delimiter before consuming it.

- **P2 — Malformed input defeats the memory bound.** [streaming.py:48](/Users/dberweger/Local/hu100-export-audit-memory-20261008/src/blueprint/streaming.py:48) treats every decode error as incomplete input and keeps appending through EOF. A broken early entry can retain the remaining export and repeatedly reparse it. **Fix:** use incremental syntax validation that rejects invalid structure without retaining the rest of the file.

- **P2 — Separate output filesystems now fail.** [export.rs:165](/Users/dberweger/Local/hu100-export-audit-memory-20261008/native/hu20-trainer/src/export.rs:165) renames the average staged beside the current output. When those destinations occupy different filesystems, this fails with `EXDEV`, after publishing current. Previously each output used its own destination-local temporary file. **Fix:** stage average beside its own destination.

Small in-memory checks passed valid audit, duplicate-current rejection, coverage mismatch, policy mismatch and ordinary truncation rejection. Numerical calculations and canonical serialization appear preserved by source inspection.

Limitations: no native build, gzip-byte equivalence check or full-size memory benchmark was run. No files were changed; no training or merge occurred.
disposition: All four findings fixed; closure independently assessed by round4 at5067434.
